fixture_name: NE Edmonton Ring Road planning-stage RSA — Canada TAC planning (real sample, Alberta Transportation 2009)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Sub-preferred systems-service spacing (1970 m/1670 m vs 3000 m) with recorded weaving pairs and a credible merge-conflict collision/congestion-propagation mechanism is substantive for an Alberta Stage 1 planning RSA.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal spacing-deficiency claim is supported by a verbatim quoted observation (EV-CA-039), and the network-wide consequence by verbatim EV-CA-003; assumptions and confidence basis are transparently flagged as inference.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a safety_concern rather than a compliance breach, treating 3000 m as preferred spacing while keeping the safety mechanism and design-response categorically distinct within CRSAG planning-stage semantics.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and actionable dual pathway—adopt 3000 m spacing in next functional plan or add collector-distributor roadways—with verification tied to 2041 staging-year weave volumes.
justifications.vru_coverage: VRUs explicitly acknowledged as not applicable because the access-controlled ring-road mainline carries no pedestrians or cyclists, matching the rubric treatment of acknowledged non-applicability.

justifications.substance: Substantive process-compliance gap: two audit-raised local-access-in-system-interchange issues left without any accept/conditionally-accept/reject decision leaves the finalised functional plan record in breach of the mandated disposition discipline, with real downstream safety consequence if retention/removal is never decided.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal claim (design team must provide a response report choosing among accept / conditionally accept with modifications / reject) is backed by the verbatim EV-CA-038 quote; EV-CA-003 verbatim grounds the fully-and-consistently-documented-actions duty and EV-CA-006 fixes the Planning Stage = Stage 1 mapping; the missing-response-report observation rests on the recorded package structure.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Framed strictly as a compliance_question about documentation procedure, kept categorically distinct from the underlying design-safety concern about driver expectation conflicts; uses Alberta-specific §5.6.2 semantics correctly with stage-equivalency anchored by EV-CA-006, no framework conflation.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and actionable — issue the §5.6.2 response report dispositioning each §4.1–4.2 issue among the three permitted responses and file it with Alberta Transportation alongside the functional plan; minor deduction risk only because §4.1–4.2 section references are internal to the audit letter rather than cited evidence.
justifications.vru_coverage: Directly not applicable since the fully access-controlled mainline carries no pedestrians or cyclists, yet the scenario acknowledges the flagged connections route traffic toward the VRU-bearing local cross-road network while honestly declining to assert unverified VRU exposure — acknowledged-but-not-applicable, scoring 1 per rubric.
